serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Oh right, I almost forgot about something.
Damn, this guy…
You: W-what is it, Mr Landlord?
Landlord: Did you hear a female voice somewhere around here? Because I thought I did.
You: N-no.
Landlord: Hmmm, you don't sound very sure about it.
You: W-well, only because I didn’t hear anything doesn’t mean that there’s no girl here.
Landlord: Right…
Landlord: But haven’t you spoken to someone when I turned my back just a second ago?
You: Of course not!
Landlord: Hmmm…{{wi}} Alright then.
Landlord: Remember to pay on time.
You: You don’t have to remind me…{{wi}} Have a nice day.
Landlord: Yeah, I will.
